% 19.05.2023 CRL.M.A.10006/2023 (early hearing)
1. As the matter is already listed today, the present application has become infructuous.
2. Accordingly, the application is disposed of.

The petitioners vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 seek quashing of FIR No.126/2013 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S.
CWC/Nanakpura, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom in view of the Settlement Deed dated 2nd August, 2022 arrived at through mediation before Mediation Centre, Dwarka Courts,
Delhi.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 17:51:45 4.

This petition is accompanied by the Settlement Deed dated 2nd August, 2022 annexed as Annexure-P4 and is supported by affidavits of all the petitioners and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.
5.
Petitioner nos.1, 2 and 3 and as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the IO.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.

It is to be noted that accused no.4 namely Bharat has since been discharged vide order dated 5th November, 2015 passed by learned MM-01/ Mahila Court (South-West), Dwarka Courts, Delhi,
which has been placed on record as Annexure A to CRL. M.A.13633/2023.
7.
Learned APP for the State confirms that he has no objection to the quashing of the said FIR.
8. Respondent no.2 confirms that petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 4th January, 2023.

She further affirms the Settlement Deed dated 2nd August, 2022 whereby the petitioner no.1 shall pay her a sum of Rs.11,50,000/- in full and final settlement of all her claims including permanent alimony,
maintenance (present, past and future), stridhan etc.
9.

She states that out of the said sum she has already received a sum of Rs.10,25,000/- and a Demand Draft bearing no.640587 dated 29th March, 2023 drawn on IDFC First Bank qua the balance amount of Rs.1,25,000/- has been handed over to her in Court by the petitioner no.1.
10.

12. Needless to state that the settlement arrived at between the parties resulting in closure of all criminal proceedings inter se the parties by way of the present order will, in no way, effect the rights of the child of the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2, namely Siddhi (minor) vis--vis her parents,
